core_obligations: Part (1) (proof lines 3826-3829): t(s^-1(W)) is the set of points of U equivalent to a point of W, via the two cited lemmas, hence set-theoretically R-invariant.
Part (2) (proof lines 3830-3831): s open implies W' = t(s^-1(W)) is an open subset of U, so it is an R-invariant open subscheme by part (1).
Part (3) (proof lines 3832-3836): for quasi-compact open W, W' is quasi-compact and open and invariant; ranging W over affine opens of U gives the covering.
proof_roadmap: Identify t(s^-1(W)) as the equivalence class union (proof lines 3826-3829).
Get openness from s open (proof lines 3830-3831).
Get quasi-compactness and the affine covering (proof lines 3832-3836).
